items.source: Extended variant of FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator for @Configuration class purposes, not only enforcing fully-qualified names for component and configuration classes themselves but also fully-qualified default bean names ("className.methodName") for @Bean methods.
items.translation: `FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 类的扩展变体，专为 `@Configuration` 类目的设计，不仅强制组件类和配置类本身使用完全限定名称，还强制 `@Bean` 方法使用完全限定的默认 Bean 名称（"className.methodName"）。

items.source: A convenient constant for a default FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator instance, as used for configuration-level import purposes.
items.translation: 一个用于配置级别导入目的的默认 `FullyQualifiedAnnotationBeanNameGenerator` 实例的便捷常量。

items.source:
Annotation support for the Application Context, including JSR-250 "common"
annotations, component-scanning, and Java-based metadata for creating
Spring-managed objects.
items.translation: 支持应用上下文的注解，包括 JSR-250“通用”注解、组件扫描以及用于创建 Spring 托管对象的基于 Java 的元数据。
